description_sq:
Shesim ambjent komercial bar-kafe.
Ambjenti ndodhet ne rrugen kryesore Besim Alla me akses shume te shpejt ne Bulevardin Migjeni te Yzberishtit dhe Rrugen Konferenca e Pezes me dalje ne Unazen e Madhe te qytetit.
I organizuar ne 200 m2 ambjent i brendshem dhe 80 m2 verande funksionale.
Funksionon prej 10 vitesh si bar-kafe dhe ambjent i vecante per lojra femijesh.
Ideale per veprimtari si bar-kafe apo edhe ndryshim destinacioni te biznesit.
Per me shume info. dhe nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni.
title_en: YZBERISH, COMMERCIAL BAR-CAFE ENVIRONMENT FOR SALE!
description_en: We are selling a bar-cafe commercial space. The facility is located on the main Besim Alla street with very quick access to Migjeni te Yzberishti Boulevard and Peze Conference Street with exit to the Great Ring of the city. Organized in 200 m2 of interior space and 80 m2 of functional veranda. It has been operating for 10 years as a coffee bar and a special area for children's games. Ideal for activities such as bar-café or even a change of business destination. For more info. and a visit to the property, contact us.
